crossRefs.note: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols. I will scatter your bones around your altars.
translations.bsb: I will lay the corpses of the Israelites before their idols and scatter your bones around your altars.
translations.kjv: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
translations.asv: And I will lay the dead bodies of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
